effects.effect: You know just where to cut your enemies. Whenever you make a [strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/strike) that has no [bane](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/bane) or double [bane](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/bane), and that incorporates 1 or more [surges](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.resource/surge), you gain 1 additional [surge](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.resource/surge) that you can use only on that [strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/strike).
